name: Zul'Farrak

entrance.note: Northwest Tanaris. Pickup hubs are Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, levels 42-47. Horde flight is Bulkrek Ragefist in Gadgetzan.

fromHubs: Gadgetzan: walk northwest to 38.7, 20.1. Tran'rek 51.6, 26.8, Trenton Lighthammer 51.4, 28.8, Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle 52.5, 28.5.
Steamwheedle Port: Yeh'kinya 67.0, 22.4 (3520/3527); ride west to Gadgetzan then the instance.
Thousand Needles (Mirage Raceway): Wizzle Brassbolts 78.1, 77.1 for optional 2770, then fly or ride to Gadgetzan.
travel.how: Fly to Gadgetzan. Set hearth at Innkeeper Fizzgrimble (Tanaris 52.51, 27.91). Ride northwest to the portal at 38.7, 20.1.

quests.name: Venom Bottles
quests.notes: Object start in the Hinterlands. Unlocks 2934. Catalog speedrun:true as a chain lead-in when you are already in Hinterlands.

quests.name: Screecher Spirits
quests.notes: Kill screechers outside ZF (Feralas). Unlocks 3527. Catalog speedrun:true when you pass Yeh'kinya.

quests.name: Tran'rek
quests.notes: Talk-only breadcrumb for 2865 (QuestieDB breadcrumbFor 2865). Catalog speedrun:false (390 XP). Balanced only in steps-v2. 2865 can be taken in Gadgetzan without this.

quests.name: Scarab Shells
quests.notes: Uncracked Scarab Shells inside. Catalog speedrun:true. dungeons.json anyOf [2864]; QuestieDB has no required pre.

quests.name: Undamaged Venom Sac
quests.notes: Undamaged Venom Sac is outside ZF (Hinterlands spiders). Unlocks 2935. Catalog speedrun:true as chain lead-in.

quests.name: Consult Master Gadrin
quests.notes: Travel to Sen'jin. Unlocks 2936. Catalog speedrun:true.

quests.name: The Spider God
quests.notes: Tablet inside ZF. Catalog speedrun:true (4850 base). Leads to 2937 (not in this pack).

quests.name: Troll Temper
quests.notes: Troll Temper drops inside. Catalog speedrun:true.

quests.name: Tiara of the Deep
quests.notes: Tiara of the Deep from Hydromancer Velratha inside. Catalog speedrun:true (6050 base). 2861 is an optional breadcrumb (QuestieDB breadcrumbFor 2846; dungeons.json 2846 has empty prereqs and 2861 leadsTo []).

quests.name: Tabetha's Task
quests.notes: Talk-only breadcrumb for 2846. Catalog speedrun:false (405 XP). Balanced only in steps-v2. dungeons.json also lists Anastasia Hartwell and Deino; QuestieDB starts from Anastasia, Deino, and Alliance mage trainers (no Ursyn). steps-v2 accept is Ursyn Ghull.

quests.name: Divino-matic Rod
quests.notes: Divino-matic Rod from Sergeant Bly after the pyramid event. Catalog speedrun:true (6300 base).

quests.name: The Prophecy of Mosh'aru
quests.notes: First and Second Mosh'aru Tablets inside. Catalog speedrun:true. Leads to 4787 (not in this pack).

quests.name: Gahz'rilla
quests.notes: Gahz'rilla's Electrified Scale. Optional; often skipped. Catalog speedrun:false and insideDungeon:false. Role tip: use the Mallet of Zul'Farrak at the gong. No mallet quest is in this pack, steps-v2, or questie-db (Qiaga the Keeper exists as an NPC in Hinterlands). Balanced only in steps-v2.

prep.group: 5-player, dungeon levels 44-54; do not enter before 47 (runAt). Pyramid stair event pulls the troll army — tank holds the top of the stairs. Sandfury shaman packs need interrupts.
warnings: Gahz'rilla (2770) is optional and often skipped. Catalog speedrun:false. Summoning uses the Mallet of Zul'Farrak at the gong; there is no mallet quest in dungeons.json / steps-v2 / questie-db.
Do not detour to Booty Bay for 2864 — take Scarab Shells (2865) in Gadgetzan.
Do not detour for 2861 if you can reach Tabetha; take 2846 directly.
Spider God chain starts from a Hinterlands venom bottle, not from Gadgetzan.
3520 is outdoor Feralas screechers before the ZF tablets (3527).

At most five dungeon entries/resets per hour. Kill XP inside dungeons is increased by 50%. If any party member would get no XP because the mobs are trivial to them, nobody in the party gets XP (Blizzard Forever hotfixes through 20 Nov 2026).

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: h4060 Gadgetzan / Steamwheedle pirate and Wastewander rounds, Dunemaul, Noxious Lair, Scrimshank, and balanced-only Thistleshrub Valley are the slow same-band overworld a ZF run at 47 replaces. Speedrun also grinds Scorpid Dunestalker to 46 before The Thirsty Goblin.
README dungeons-off includes Feralas. Camp Mojache Woodpaw / Gordunni loop in h4060 is the same band as ZF pickup (42-47).

sourceConflicts: 2865 prerequisites: dungeons.json anyOf [2864]; QuestieDB and web/public/data/quests.json have no required pre (2864 is breadcrumbFor 2865).
2861 leadsTo is [] in dungeons.json; QuestieDB next/breadcrumbFor is 2846. 2846 has empty prereqs in dungeons.json.
2861 givers: steps-v2 accept is Ursyn Ghull Thunder Bluff 25.7, 14.2; dungeons.json lists Ursyn, Anastasia, and Deino; QuestieDB start npcs are 4568, 5144, 5497, 5885 (no Ursyn).
2770 insideDungeon:false in dungeons.json while the boss is inside ZF; speedrun:false because of mallet / extra travel. No Sacred Mallet / Mallet of Zul'Farrak quest exists in the catalog.
Classic Era XP in dungeons.json; catalog notes Forever may halve dungeon-quest bonus XP (unofficial). Amounts here are Classic Era base.
notes: Horde-available Classic dungeon (neutral givers in Gadgetzan). Pickup hub is Gadgetzan and Steamwheedle Port, levels 42-47. Dungeons-off: Tanaris, Feralas and The Hinterlands. One quested clear; do not reset-farm. XP figures are Classic Era from dungeons.json / questie-db / web/public/data/quests.json.
